visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-quality animation phase featuring a young boy with glasses (Conan) navigating a vibrant, neon-lit futuristic city on a high-tech skateboard. His facial expression is determined, and his hands grip the board's edge as he leans into a turn. The urban background is filled with towering skyscrapers and glowing digital billboards. (2) A transition occurs to a stylized graphic phase showing news clippings and thematic cards. A tall figure in a white cape and top hat (Kaitou Kid) is depicted in a silhouette-style illustration. (3) The scene shifts to in-game mobile gameplay footage. A character model named Yong, wearing a Conan-inspired outfit, is shown performing combat moves in a fantasy battle arena with green grass and stone paths. (4) A character introduction phase displays a female character (Mori Ran) in a blue school uniform standing in a serene outdoor setting at night, with rocky hills and a clear starry sky behind her. (5) Another gameplay phase shows a character named Hayate wearing a white thief costume, executing rapid combat maneuvers that generate magical playing card effects on screen. (6) A cinematic phase returns to the animated city, focusing on the thief character standing on a high rooftop overlooking the cityscape. The lighting is dominated by cool blue tones and bright searchlights. (7) The final phase shows a rapid montage of character models, including a male character in a suit on a monitor screen, concluding with the official collaboration logos for the game and the anime series displayed against a dark backdrop.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with high-energy, upbeat electronic music featuring a driving synthesizer beat and a clear kick drum rhythm at approximately 128 BPM. A male speaker introduces the topic in a highly animated, enthusiastic tone with a fast speech rate and clear articulation. (2) A mechanical 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as visual titles change, followed by the sound of a skateboard rolling with a frictional texture. The speaker continues describing event dates with rising intonation patterns. (3) An impact SFX resembling a sword slash and an energy blast accompanies in-game footage, blending with the rhythmic pulse of the BGM. (4) A digital UI 'ping' sound marks a transition to a new character reveal. The speaker's voice maintains high arousal as he highlights a birthday note in the narration. (5) Fluttering card SFX and magical hit sounds become dominant as gameplay mechanics are shown. The music remains consistent in its major-mode progression. (6) A cinematic 'bell' chime and a low-frequency 'boom' occur during the thief character's appearance, adding a layer of dramatic sound design. (7) The speaker's volume increases as he delivers a call-to-action, punctuated by a quick succession of interface 'beeps' and a final triumphant musical chord.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional news summary designed to inform the mobile gaming community about a limited-time collaboration event between Arena of Valor and the Detective Conan franchise. By leveraging high-energy narration, fast-paced visual editing, and a clear chronological list of rewards and skin releases, the content aims to build excitement, encourage player login, and drive in-game purchases during the month of August.
